tips.en: During an earthquake: Duck, Cover, and Hold until the shaking stops.
tips.fil: Kapag lumindol: Duck, Cover, and Hold hanggang tumigil ang pagyanig.

tips.en: A Go Bag has water, food, a flashlight, a whistle, and a first-aid kit.
tips.fil: Ang Go Bag ay may tubig, pagkain, flashlight, pito, at first-aid kit.

tips.en: Never walk, swim, or play in floodwater. It can be deeper and dirtier than it looks.
tips.fil: Huwag lumusong, lumangoy, o maglaro sa baha. Maaari itong mas malalim at mas marumi kaysa sa inaakala.

tips.en: Know two ways out of every room at home and in school.
tips.fil: Alamin ang dalawang daan palabas sa bawat silid sa bahay at paaralan.

tips.en: PAGASA watches the weather. PHIVOLCS watches volcanoes and earthquakes.
tips.fil: Binabantayan ng PAGASA ang panahon. Binabantayan ng PHIVOLCS ang bulkan at lindol.

tips.en: Wash your hands for 20 seconds — about as long as singing 'Happy Birthday' twice.
tips.fil: Maghugas ng kamay nang 20 segundo — mga dalawang beses na pagkanta ng 'Happy Birthday'.

tips.en: If your clothes catch fire: Stop, Drop, and Roll!
tips.fil: Kapag nasunog ang damit mo: Stop, Drop, and Roll!

tips.en: The Philippines is in both the Pacific Ring of Fire and the Typhoon Belt.
tips.fil: Ang Pilipinas ay nasa Pacific Ring of Fire at Typhoon Belt.

tips.en: Feeling scared after a disaster is normal. Talk to someone you trust.
tips.fil: Normal lang matakot pagkatapos ng sakuna. Kausapin ang taong pinagkakatiwalaan mo.

tips.en: Learn your full name, your parent's name, and their phone number by heart.
tips.fil: Kabisaduhin ang buong pangalan mo, ang pangalan ng magulang mo, at ang kanilang numero.

tips.en: Kalasag means shield. Being prepared is your shield!
tips.fil: Ang kalasag ay panangga. Ang pagiging handa ang iyong kalasag!

tips.en: If you are trapped in a building during an earthquake, stay away from windows and heavy objects.
tips.fil: Kung ikaw ay na-trap sa isang gusali habang may lindol, lumayo sa mga bintana at mabibigat na bagay.

tips.en: Listen look and listen and learn!
